name: wraps greedily without subjective reflow
input: ordinary words that leave a one-word final line
test:
assert format_articles(['one two three'], 7) == ['one two', 'three']
assert format_articles(['oversized'], 3) == ['oversized']

name: attaches punctuation-leading tokens with the overflow exception
input: a punctuation-leading token after a full line and one at article start
test:
assert format_articles(['Hello ,world next'], 5) == ['Hello ,world', 'next']
assert format_articles(['!alert ok'], 6) == ['!alert', 'ok']

name: places separators exactly between articles including empty ones
input: a nonempty article, an empty middle article, and a final nonempty article
